m48a3_patton.name: M48A3 Patton
m48a3_patton.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-29 (~11:00, owner's blanket approval; DECISIONS) that a photo-built id with no oracle qualifies stage A through a per-id photo packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS. M48A3 Patton is a release-266 build on the M48A5's measured castings from photographs (the owner, 2026-10-28: "add a new m48 variant for the usa since its a really great modeel"); its blind photo critic passed at 8/10. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified: no owner model exists for this mark.
m48a3_patton.envelopeBasis: As built. Width over the fender lips and the fender bins (the published 3.63 m is over the tracks). Length from the stern plate to the M41's T-shaped deflector (published 8.69 m over the gun). Tallest is the tips of the two whip antennas on the bustle, as built rather than published; the published 3.12 m height is to the M1 cupola's .50, which the build holds. docs/references/tanks/m48a3_patton.md records the sources and photographs.
